runner_measurement_proposal.status: PROPOSED_NOT_RUN; instruction for existing Runner owner, not a measurement
prerequisites: Resolve matching parent native artifacts or existing exact-parent counter results; record hashes and configuration.
Confirm Runner can read the exact candidate bytes identified here; do not assume this producer path is shared.

Use existing calibrated Runner counter/instrumentation. Record whether it is physical hardware or an emulator; report actual clock and measurement scope. No device write or duplicate Runner job is authorized by this manifest.
runner_measurement_proposal.source_of_workload: tests/host/juno6_matched_bench.c at protocol driver_sha256; this is internal DSP state, not a plugin preset
initialization: Zero complete synth/chorus state. Call juno6_init and juno6_chorus_init with 44100. Call juno6_set(s,8,1.0f). Keep remaining init defaults, including macro[15]/1.85f and chorus 0.8 Hz / 3.4 ms / mix 0.22.
For N voices, call note_on for notes 48+3*i, i=0..N-1, velocity 100; set each envelope 0.8f, stage 3/gate 1 for held or stage 4/gate 0 for release.

Copy the same complete initial state before every measured leg outside the timed region. Each leg executes 16 times: render 256 frames, copy mono to right, chorus_process 256 frames. Keep allocations, state reset, logging and checksums outside timing.
runner_measurement_proposal.fixed_schedule: Use the existing matched workload if already queued. Otherwise the bounded host schedule is 15 trials per case; 16 alternating ABBA/BAAB quartets plus 16 interleaved same-artifact A/A controls per trial. Rotate case order and warm both variants identically; preserve all raw samples. No repeat-until-pass. Reversing host object link order is a host control, not a change to native binaries.
minimal_native_output: Artifact SHA256 for both variants and models, exact source commits, SDK/compiler/configuration, counter/instrumentation version, physical-device versus emulator identity, actual clock/timebase and interrupt policy.

Raw ordered repeated cycles or calibrated execution-time measurements for each case and A/A control, with block/voice counts, measurement scope, warmup/reset details and counter wrap handling. If only render is instrumentable, label that scope and do not compare it directly to host render+copy+chorus totals.
Paired median and tail summaries, control variability, time/cycle resolution and any deadline/XRUN evidence already available from the same run. Absence of such telemetry is NOT a zero-XRUN result.

Decision: reject an established matched regression; if controls/resolution are insufficient keep INCONCLUSIVE and PR draft. A passing device result does not itself close the separately unresolved host gate.
limits: A hardware target timing result requires a real target counter or independently validated target-cycle model. Emulator host wall time is not target/device CPU.
44.1kHz and256frames imply a block period256/44100seconds by arithmetic; this is not a measured latency or deadline margin.
No device write/install, firmware publication, merge, or schema/preset work is authorized. Source/CPU evidence remains separate from UI frames and J6/plugin preset formats.
